@graph.name: Cryolipolysis
@graph.description: Reshape Your Body with Cryolipolysis / Cool Sculpting Treatment in Bangalore Non-invasive fat reduction for a slimmer, contoured you, available at Derma Solutio
@graph.howPerformed: Our specialists first assess your body goals and choose the treatment areas. A cooling applicator is placed on the targeted area, and fat cells are cooled to a precise temperature that triggers their natural elimination. Sessions typically last 35–60 minutes. Beforehand, avoid heavy meals and alcohol, and wear loose, comfortable clothing.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients feel a mild cooling sensation, which fades within minutes as the area becomes numb.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results show within 4–6 weeks, with the full effect visible after about 3 months.
